responsibility: This definition module provides the ISO-style COROUTINES compatibility types used by the gm2 runtime, specifically the interrupt source and protection-priority range definitions. It belongs to the coroutine/interrupt support layer and exports the priority model constants and types that other runtime modules such as RTint use to classify and dispatch interrupt sources, without implementing coroutine scheduling itself.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the COROUTINES pair: this file is the one that exports the ISO-compatible interrupt and protection-priority types/constants, whereas COROUTINES.mod is just an empty companion body.
